ai.title: Open-source AI may aid climate and development but deepen inequality, experts warn
ai.description: Open-source artificial intelligence is advancing faster than the world can govern it, and the consequences could reshape the future of sustainability, democracy and global development. In a new comment published in Nature Communications, an international team of researchers warns that without coordinated action, open-source AI could also increase environmental pressures, deepen technological inequalities and facilitate the spread of misinformation.
ai.title_cn: 专家警告称，开源人工智能可能有助于气候和发展，但会加深不平等
ai.description_cn: 开源人工智能的发展速度超出了世界对其治理的速度，其后果可能会重塑可持续发展、民主和全球发展的未来。在《自然通讯》上发表的一篇新评论中，一个国际研究人员团队警告说，如果不采取协调行动，开源人工智能还可能增加环境压力、加深技术不平等并促进错误信息的传播。
